card.name: The word plunge and a few others
card.fires_on: Mostly the word "plunge" (a fall or sudden drop, as a verb or noun) in general news and science text. Weaker on "alongside" and "impossible".

modes.label: plunge
modes.description: The word plunge used for a sudden drop in temperature, price, or a craft falling through the atmosphere.

modes.label: alongside
modes.description: The word alongside meaning together with or at the same time as something.
modes.example: High doses of zinc can interfere with the absorption of iron when taken<< alongside>> iron supplements.
